breakeven_odds_formula: mindestquote = 1 / win_rate  (decimal odds needed so that, at this win rate, wins on average cover losses; anything below this quote runs at a loss even if the win rate holds)

MoneyBag 2-0/0-2 -> Over 2.5.note: Confirmed across two independent weekly exports (n=4501 combined): win rate holds ~65-81% for minutes 55-67, then drops sharply at 68-70 (65%, 41%, 51%) before a noisy late bounce. Tightening the upper cutoff trades volume for precision.

MoneyBag + 3 Goals -> Over 3.5.note: Confirmed across two exports (n=3591 combined): minutes 60-63 solid (67-75%), then a clear dip at 64-65 (~60%), a partial recovery at 66-67, then decay again through 71. <=63 is the conservative cutoff; the 66-67 recovery is noisier and not worth complicating the rule for.

Over 2.5 Odd Filter.note: New variant introduced 2026-09-27 (adds a minimum Over-odds filter on top of the base Over 2.5 rule). Performance and time-decay pattern are statistically indistinguishable from the base 'MoneyBag 2-0/0-2 -> Over 2.5' strategy, so the same dakika<=67 cutoff applies. Only one week of data so far (n=696); re-check once a second export confirms the pattern.

Over 0.5 Value.note: Signals fire almost exclusively at minute 61-62 despite the rule allowing up to 79'; minute 61 (72.5%, n=345) slightly outperforms 62 (67.2%, n=64). Too little data past minute 62 to judge whether the wide 61-79 window is actually a risk - most of it appears unused in practice. Revisit once more late-minute signals accumulate.

MoneyBag 0-0 -> Goal.note: Same pattern as 'Over 0.5 Value': signals cluster at minute 61-62 even though the rule allows up to 71'. Minute 61 (77.2%, n=123) outperforms minute 62 (66.7%, n=69). No signals observed yet in the 63-71 range to evaluate - can't confirm or rule out a late-minute drop with current data.

Over 1.5.current_rule: dakika <= 75 | dakika >= 60 | paraCuvali = 1 | son5iki >= 60 | toplamGol = 1 | toplamSutTotal >= 15 | ustAdayi = 1
Over 1.5.note: Solid win rate (78-85%) at minutes 60-61 (n=96, n=20), a single low outlier at 63 (60%, n=10, too small to act on). Almost no signals fire past minute 63 despite the rule's 75' ceiling - the other filters (toplamSutTotal>=15, son5iki>=60) apparently already gate out late signals in practice.

Over 1.5 cloude.current_rule: dakika <= 75 | dakika >= 60 | paraCuvali = 1 | rx >= 300 | son5iki >= 60 | toplamGol = 1 | toplamSutTotal >= 15 | ustAdayi = 1
Over 1.5 cloude.note: Same shape as 'Over 1.5': strong at 60-62 (74-80%), thin data beyond that. The added rx>=300 filter doesn't show a clear effect yet given the small sample.

Over 1.5 claude 1.änderung.current_rule: dakika <= 75 | dakika >= 60 | paraCuvali = 1 | rx >= 300 | son5iki >= 60 | toplamGol = 1 | toplamSutTotal >= 10 | ustAdayi = 1
Over 1.5 claude 1.änderung.note: Best-performing of the three Over 1.5 variants so far (74.6% vs 72.5-72.6%), likely just the lower toplamSutTotal>=10 threshold letting in a few more good signals. Sample still small (n=193, split across 8 minute values with <35 each) - not yet enough to confidently prefer this variant over the other two.

HT over 0.5.current_rule: dakika <= 20 | dakika >= 10 | maviBomba = 1 | rx <= 178 | s5 >= 2 | toplamGol <= 1 | toplamSut >= 3 | vanPersie = 1
HT over 0.5.note: Confirmed weak across both weekly exports (57.5% then 56.8%, combined 56.8% n=44) - clearly underperforms every other strategy (70-81%) and has the thinnest odds margin (+0.18). Two independent samples agreeing is a stronger signal than either alone: this rule likely needs a real redesign (different rx/toplamSut thresholds), not just more data.

breakeven_odds_by_signal_minute.note: Mindestquote per signal-minute bucket, overall across strategies, combined across both 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-27 exports (n=10000).

breakeven_odds_by_strategy_and_signal_mi.note: Mindestquote per strategy x signal-minute bucket (n>=15), combined across both exports. avg_over_odds is the observed average Over-odds for that combination. margin = avg_over_odds - breakeven_odds; negative would mean the strategy already runs at a loss in that time window at typically available odds.

tool_calibration.note: Source of truth for tools/moneybag-analyst.html's DEFAULT_CALIB. Recomputed from data/inplayflux_sinyaller_2026-09-20.csv (5000 signals) to replace the tool's previous 30.08.-14.09.2026 window. Not yet re-synced to the combined 2-week dataset - the tool's minute buckets differ from the ones used above, so re-syncing needs a dedicated pass rather than a copy-paste.

radar_x_score.note: No strong monotonic relationship with win rate (71-75% across all buckets from <200 to >=450 in the 2026-09-27 export, consistent with 2026-09-20). Not currently a reliable standalone filter.

market_drop_pct.note: Fairly flat to slightly declining (57-74%) across 0-30% drop in the 2026-09-27 export, with a dip at 20-30% (56.6%, n=83). Direction is inconsistent with the 2026-09-20 export (which saw a jump at >=30%) - too noisy on small samples to draw a conclusion yet.
